summary: Re-enables the aggregate JaCoCo XML/HTML report and adds per-job Codecov upload plus a manual-trigger finalization job to the PR workflow, committing the public Codecov upload token as a fallback for fork PRs.

tests.evidence: CI/build change; no driver behavior changed, validated by the Codecov run on the PR itself.

user_docs.evidence: Adds a Code coverage section to TESTING.md; its -Pcoverage claim matches build-logic.java.gradle.kts:50 (coverage param or a jacoco task name).

doc_comments.evidence: Many new explanatory comments in main.yml/matrix.mjs/codecov.yml; mostly accurate.

change_description.evidence: Detailed why/what and token rationale; the first commit message still says only omni.yml uploads, but the PR body is current.

performance.evidence: Instrumentation slows tests and crashed Windows workers; commit 3ed0b449 already limits coverage to ubuntu jobs.

security.evidence: Commits a Codecov upload token in plain text in main.yml (`token: ${{ env.CODECOV_TOKEN || '75d2...' }}`) and exposes secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN as a job-level env var visible to every build/test step; credentials handling in CI needs a deliberate check.

backward_compat.evidence: No public API or driver behavior touched.

correctness.evidence: Non-trivial workflow conditions: codecov.yml `manual_trigger: true` also applies to the unchanged omni.yml uploads, which never call send-notifications, so those runs never notify; the `Tests` job, described as an aggregate gate, runs with if: always() and fail_ci_if_error: false and never checks needs.build-test.result, so it passes when the matrix fails.

surprising_behavior.evidence: A job named `Tests` that always succeeds could be mistaken for a required-check gate (see correctness).

contradictions.evidence: build.gradle.kts comment says Codecov consumes the XML 'see .github/workflows/omni.yml' while main.yml is now the PR uploader; omni.yml still labels the same codecov-action SHA `# v6` and uses the old `file:` input while main.yml calls it v7.0.0 with `files:`.

build_ci.evidence: Changes build.gradle.kts, build-logic jacoco plugin, main.yml, matrix.mjs, codecov.yml.

plan.why: Workflow logic and cross-file consistency form one review; the committed token and secret exposure deserve a separate security pass.
